balls.text: and RP gets away with a length delivery, Oram backs away and swings, gets an inside edge onto the pad, and RP is alert to field it, and misses out on running Oram out, who has been sent back by Gony
and this was always coming, just back of a length, Badri throws his bat at it, top-edges it, it goes miles in the air, and RP catches it on the adjacent pitch
and another dot ball from Badri, tries to scoop, RP throws it wide, and no contact here
length ball, and Oram misses out, clears the leg, swings, but hits straight to deep backward square; had Shoaib not dropped it this would have been a second catch off a free hit today
oh no RP, not again, third no-ball from RP today, fourth free hit today
but RP uses the same head that he wears the purple cap on, to bowl a slower bouncer, and beats a swipe from Oram
and what a gem Oram is playing, he backs away again, picks this length delivery, and swats it straight over RP's head, not too high, had he hit RP, where would he wear the purple cap?
bouncer, and Badri -facing such pace - is like a hare caught in headlights, misses a swipe, not his game to come out and start swinging right away
just short of a yorker, Oram backs away and hits it towards sweeper-cover
top shot, slower bouncer, seems Oram saw it coming, stands in the crease, clears the front leg, and pulls it to deep backwards sqaure leg boundary
goes back, heaves, is too late into the shot, and ends up lobbing it with one hand, just short of mid-off
full, straight, almost a yorker, Badri makes room, and hits straight to point
fast, angling in, 140ks, and Badri is way late into his poke
slower ball, wide outside off, and Badri plays with an open face to retain strike for the next over
fulltoss, chipped over extra cover for two
slowe rball, Oram was stepping out, and he plays it straight down to long-off
mis-hit, makes room, a touch slower, comes off the splice of the bat, but it still goes 10 rows over wide long-off, what a good bat it must be
this could have been 12, makes room, then shofts back, this is a length ball, and he lofts it straight over, and it's way over the straight boundary
lovely shot, this one was just inches short of being a yorker, but was wide, and Oram waited and sort of scooped it over the point, there is no deep thirdman
what outfield, this is fast, really fast, this was short outside off, Badri opened the face, and it wasn't hit hard, but the fall ran past the third man in a hurry
what price justice indeed, this is a much better hit, off the middle, slog sweep, goes where he wants it to, towards deep midwicket, and finds the boundary fielder, poetic justice
mis-hit goes for a six, what price justice, he slog-sweeps, and clears the long-on, only just, and he looked at his bat after hitting it, as if not pleased the wood
fulltoss on the pads, hit flat and straight, just wide of long-on
full and straight, and hit straight towards long-on
sees him coming down, waits an extra half-second shortens the length, and played towards short third
first length ball of the over, and gives Morkel the room to swing, he swats it down the ground after clearing his leg
lovely bowling, swinging yorker, starting from outside leg and ending off, and he gets a single only because it is not too fast
yorker on off, swinging away, and just a single to cover
well bowled, Oram looks to make room, and the bowler throws it wide, away from the batsman
length ball, outside off, goes for it, but doesn't get hold of it, and it falls short of long-off
swinging fulltoss, and played with an open face towards sweeper-cover
short and wide, and but only a single to sweeper-cover
yorker, and another dot ball, good comeback after being taken for four
good comeback, slower this time, thrown up, and beats him on the sweep
flighted outside off, and Oram gets a full swing this time, clears the extra cover with ease
just short of elngth, and outside off, and a single into the off side
flighted outside off, and a single to wide of long-off
another bouncer, and Morkel's weight is forward, and he ends up ducking, only three off the over, Deccan are right back
slower ball, pitched outside leg, and turning towards stumps, and flicked away to fine leg
lovely bowling, Oram looks to make room, Edwards follows and bowls a bouncer, Oram is now swaying outside the line, saving his face, literally
bouncer, Oram rocks back, goes deep into the crease, and pulls it wide of midwicket for two
back of a length, starts off, and angles away, and Oram lets it go again
length delivery, just outside off, goes with the angle, and oram doesn't fiddle with it

what a big over from Ojha, two wickets, and it is Hayden now, the big fish, this is bowled full, into the pads, Hayden is looking to charge down, but is cramped by it, and is too close to the ball, so doesn't get elevation, and it goes straight to midwicket
flighted just outside off, and played down towards long-off
is greeted by a yorker, always tough for a tall man to come down to it
Ojha gets another one, gets this to rip, Dhoni has stepped out, is short of the pitch, he is looking extra cover, but this slices off the face and lobs straight to sweeper-cover
full and straight again, and Hayden plays towards long-off
full, on the pads, steps out, drives straight down the ground
into the stumps, and defended towards midwicket
was there a nick?, Dhoni steps out, is beaten by a length ball that holds its length, a noise there, but only midwicket appeals big time, and it's not given
this one was coming, Hayden was always walking down first ball, Shoaib pulls his length back, Hayden flat-bats it into the stumps at the non-striker's end, which saves three
this one stopped a but after pitching, 117ks, on the off stump, played towards long-off
hits the deck again, seams in after pitching, Dhoni steps out, but hits it back to Shoaib who does well to dive to his left and save the single
starts off with a wide, tall fellow, hits the deck, but wrong line, and it angles down the leg
on the pads, full, and an easy single towards midwicket
gentle paddle this time, premeditates, but succeeds, just guiding it past short fine, and the outfield is very quick
full and straight, played to the bowler
mis-hits a pull, high on the bat, but lands short of deep backward square
continues over the wicket to Dhoni, full, on the off stump, and knocked down to long-off
over the wicket to Hayden, angling in, full, and played down the ground
full, on the pads, and an easy single to long-on
another fast delivery, on the pads, and an easy single to fine leg
good comeback, bowled from round the wicket, flat and fast, played back to the bowler
that's viontage Dhoni, he has been stepping out today, but gets right to the pitch now, it's a flat delivery, and he lofts it over wide long-on
angled down the leg side
Hayden steps out, takes three steps, Venu is shorter still, smart bowlinmg, and all Hayden manages is a single to long-off
thrown up, full and Dhoni steps out and hits to long-on
almost a yorker, full and straight, and Hayden drills it back to the bowler
Dhoni steps out, still not close to the pitch, and plays it down the group to mid-on
and now he bunts it into the covers for a single
what a good shot to break the shackles, this was overpitched, and a proper cover-drive, wide of extra cover, which runs all the way
Dhoni steps out, Rohit shortens the length, and it's just a single to midwicket
pitched up, just outside off, driven hard, to long-off
good bowl again, thrown up on the stumps, straightens a touch as opposed to turning in, and Dhoni defends it back to the bowler
short, flat, but not wide, Hayden blasts it, but straight towards sweeper-cover
angling into the leg stump, and played towards midwicket
pitched up, flighted on the stumps, and played down to long-off
thrown up, inviting Dhoni to go big, he steps out and hits it hard straight to long-off
full, on the pads, dot ball, hit towards midwicket
full, into the pads,a nd helps it away for a single to fine leg, what an over, three runs and a wicket, and Gilchrist's ploy of using part-time spinners has worked

finally they hold on to a catch, and what a catch it is, thrown up to Raian who absolutely murders it back to Sharma, low and fast, there is not even a second to react, but Sharma bends low and catches it smoothly, throws it  miles in the air to celebrate, and what a catch it was, no lesser celebration would to justice to it
good arm ball, short and wide, Raina looks for cut, but this one goes with the arm, bounces a bit too, and beats Raina
flat this time, full, and Hayden looks for big shot over extra, but manages only an inside edge
pitched outside off, thrown up, and Raina takes a single to long-off
almost a yorker, outside off, and Raina misses out on the drive
almost played on, good arm ball, Hayden looks for the cut, is cramped for room, the ball bounces inside the crease off the inside edge, and then over the stumps
well bowled this time, Raina looks to go over extra, slows it down, 88ks, and Raina is early into the shot, and checks the shot, and gets a single to long-off
steps down this time, Venu fires it down the leg side, cramps him up, and only a single
full, on the stumps, Hayden defends, is he sizing him up?
fuller this time, and he helps himself to a single down to long-off
thre result is no surprise, if you bowl short and wide to Raina, inside the Powerplay, you get smashed away for four
and it is followed by another bad delivery, gentle fulltoss on off, and Hayden doesn't look the gift horse in the mouth, four to wide of long-off
first good ball of the over, just back of a length, on the stumps, and they still manage a single to cover
full, on the pads, and helped away towards midwicket, superb batting, four and then one
smart shot, short, and angling across, Hayden knows there is no deep thirdman, and Hayden goes up and over, not a powerful shot, just lobbing it over the infield
fuller, on the pads, and helped away for an easy single
and this is not what you bowl to Raina, gentle pace, short, and on the pads, and Raina pulls it way over midwicket
shortish and wide, Hayden waits and cuts, but can't beat backward point
strays onto the pads this time, and Hayden makes half a movement down and swats it across wide of midwicket
Bilkahia catches this time, but it won't help, good free-hit delivery, Raina swings from a length, gets a top-edge that flies high to gully, and they will get one
they both get it wrong here, RP bowls a length ball, no-ball again, and Hayden goes for the almighty swing, but mis-hits towards mid-on. Raina on strike
and this is a wide, he tries the bouncer, not a bad call, but the problem is it is too high, and he has exhausted his one bouncer for the over
oh jeez no-ball, Hayden doesn't go for a shot, he wants the free hit all to himself, no field changes either
looks to scoop, and gets hit in the ribs, premeditates the shot, RP shortens his length, and it bounces into his ribs, a lesser man would have shown more pain

and Raina continues to live a charmed life, he has had enough of the bouncers, looks to pull this on, over long-on, but there is no room, and it comes on quickly onto him, he ends up slicing it, but the mid-off is too deep
short, 128ks, on the stumps, gets it rib-high, and tucks Raina up, who plays it back to the bowler
lovely bouncer, 147ks, and it passes in front of Hayden's face, he doesn't want to have anything to do with it. What a contest, pity it's a Twenty20 and this contest won;t go on for long
another drop, lovely bowling, slower, still at 123ks, gets the edge, and the ball is dying in front of first slip, Gilchrist has to go for it, manages just to get his left hand onto it
oh what a shot, Hayden looks in hot touch, walks down again, perfectly good delivery, just short of length, on off, and he crashes it through the off side again
starts wider this time, not swinging in, and Hayden lets it go
fulltoss, on the off stump, slight error, and Hayden makes him pay, crashing it through off side
fast, really fast, , and beats Hayden outside off
and how Raina makes RP pay for that wide ball, this wasn't a half-volley at all, but Raina gets right down to the pitch, on a knee, swings his arms cleanly, and a six over extra, fantastic shot
that just angles down leg side
oh Bilakhia, first touch on the ball, and he has dropped Raina, short, moving away from Raina, and he guides it neck high to gully, where it goes straight in and straight out
oh so close, RP surprises Hayden with his bouncer, which is usually very deceptive, and Hayden is late into the hook, and it bounces just short of mid-on
Hayden's walk has worked superbly, it shortens RP's length, and widens it, and Hayden just stands backs and enjoys, cutting it between point and cover
but silly mid-off won't bother Hayden, who walks down and pulls the short delivery over midwicket
and almost an edge, full and wide, moving away, hayden wants to go for it without feet movement, and is beaten
and he almost got him with this bouncer, 141ks, rising into his face, and Raina fends at it, luckily it lobs into vacant region in covers
tucks him with a sharp rising delivery, on middle stump, not really short, but rises fast into his body
floated wide outwside off, not swinging this time, Raina looks to cut without any feet movement, and misses
good shot right away, full, swinging in, Raina walks a cross and turns it down to fine leg

and Fidel strikes second up, and three matches ina  row we have the scorecard reading 0 for 1, this was fast, 142ks, bouncing into his ribs, and Parthiv gloves it down the leg side. Unlucky way to get out, but it was a good delivery, surprising Parthiv with the bounce
good start, on target, fast, 141ks, moving in from outside off
and Deccan have doubled their points tally from last year, short and wide and cut over point, easy win despite a last-over finish
full, outside off, and an easy single to long-off
and Gibbs has planned it perfectly, he knew a slower ball was coming along, he makes room, waits and slogs it into the leg side, clearing the short square boundary, what a knock
makes room, follows him with a yorker, just a single
goes for the scoop again, it's a length delivery, but he misses, and is saved from the lbw because it hits him outside the line of off
yorker, follows a Gibbs who wants to make room, he gets an inside edge, the ball goes slowly towards dee backward square, and they hurry through for two, good running
another fulltoss, knee high, and played towards midwicket for one
good shot, length ball, outside off, Azhar makes room, and hits through extra cover, not enough power, but two taken
Dhoni was signalling for slower behind Azhar's back, slower ball it is, Azhar goes for the paddle over short fine, but misses, yet gets a leg-bye
shapes up for the scoop again, slower delivery, so he changes the shot and plays with an open face towards third man
full, played to long-on, Axhar puts pressure calling for two, results ina  fumble, and an easy two
slower ball, just outside off, and beats Gibbs's dab aimed at thirdman
cool Gibbs coolly hits a four, fulltoss on the pads, he bends a bit, scoops it, actually flicks it, over short fine, and it bounces just inside the ropes
short of a length, angling in, easy single to square leg
slower ball, just outside off, too full, and an easy single to wide of point
yorker on the leg stump, played straight to midwicket
yorker outside off, Gibbs gets an inside edge, and Dhoni dives to his left to save three
full outside off, worked into the off side for a single
high fulltoss again, Gibbs plays it down to long-on to get a single, what's with tactics of bowling high fulltosses?
worst delivery possible, Gibbs steps out, and another fulltoss tried, a beamer, beats Dhoni too, five runs, no ball

fulltoss, high, and Raina has almsot worked the magic, played straight to short cover, and Gibbs has just taken two steps backing up, but Raina swoops, slides and hits direct. Gibbs has just made it, by one split frame, and gets an overthrow
another toppie, another dot, Murali has done the best he could from his last over, one run and a wicket
beats him with the doosra, outside off, Bilakhia goes back to defend but plays down the wrong line
topspinner, just outside off, hurrying the batsman up, another dot ball
flighted, dipping, on the leg, dot ball towards midwicket

Murali strikes in his last over, the last throw of Dhoni's dice has worked, this was a perfect delivery from round the stumps, sharp offbreak, pitching offish, and straightening, beating the forward defensive
dips, flighted, dipping, onto the pads, and defended
one fulltoss too many Jake, high fulltoss, cramping Smith up, but his flick gets the power from the wrists, and sails over midwicket, and the over has lost all its respect now
fulltoss, on the off stump, and Gibbs makes room and hits it straight down to long-off
yorker, on off stump, Gibbs digs it out well, but can't beat extra cover
fulltoss, on the off stump, and driven with an open face, wide of sweeper-cover
slower ball, smartly played, he has hit the four, and now takes a single to wide of point
back of a length, 120ks, Smith walks down, and pulls on the top of the bounce, and beats midwicket, good start by Smith
slower ball, 99ks, angled into the pads, Gibbs is early and is beaten
length ball, on off stump, and a crisp drive right away, through the off side
those two dot balls have done the job, this is short and slightly slower, Rohit makes room to cut, but it's not wide enough, gets the edge, what a comeback by Bala
yorker, on off stump, Rohit digs out, and plays towards extra cover
gets away with it this time, short and wide, Rohit cuts from where he stood and is beaten
slower ball, grips a lot, bounces off a length, and Gibbs takes the bottom hand off and gets a single towards point
low fulltoss, hit wide enough of Hayden at long-on to come back for a second, smart batting
another slower ball, but too short, and an easy single to short thirdman
slower ball again, just outside off, and dabbed away towards thirdman
looks to scoop, but is early in the shot, still stands tall, and turns it towards square leg
Gibbs steps out, but this is slower, and ends up hitting it straight towards extra cover
starts with a fulltoss, and Rohit plays it gently down the ground
fullish, outside off, and driven away to long-off. A good spell from Raian, 18 runs and two wickets, and the reason why we are still watching this game; it would have been over otherwise
fuller and slower, and Gibbs turns it off the face of the bat into the leg side
the first short delivery from Raian that has been punished, onto the pads and Gibbs rocks backs and pulls, four to deep backward
short, slow, and Raina goes straight, for a single down to long-on
slides onto the pads, and played away into the leg side
flighted on the off stump, and Gibbs defends it, playing Raina with respect
that was quick thinking from both, Gibbs shaped up for the scoop, Joginder went for a yorker outside off, and Gibb s quickly changed the shot, taking a single to short thirdman
full, onto the pads, and turned away for a single
120ks, short, angling into the pads, and Rohit clears his leg, and lofts it over wide long-on, no mpower just timing, super shot
fuller this time, outside off, and tapped into the off side
short and wide, 117ks, and Gibbs is back into hitting mode, between point and cover
short ball, stopped a bit, and Rohit stands tall to get a single to long-off
pitched up on the pads, and hit straight down to long-on for a single
well fielded by Raina, superbly fielded, thrown up, Rohit looks to mid-on, Raina moves that side, but he is early into it, and the shot goes towards mid-off and Raina dives to save the run
short, into the pads, and hit away towards midwicket for a single
flat, into the pads, and played towards midwicket
late cut, was fullish and wide, and but played well by Gibbs
short and wide, and dabbed away
thrown up, on off, again going away from Gibbs, he plays with soft hands, but straight to Hayden at short third
short, moving away from Rohit, and he cuts for a single to cover
short, on the pads, and pulled away
thrown up on the off stump, and played straight down the ground
offbreak but starts outside off
Murali bowls a toppie, starts off, and played towards short third man and they scamper through
angled into the pads, and played stright to midwicket
thrown up outside off, and a single into the covers
full, on off stump, and defended
and Raian strikes again, he is wearing yellow, but his arm has been gold, a mirror image of Gilchrist's dismissal, short and wide, and Laxman cuts in the air, stright to backward point
into the pads again, and nudged away again
angled into the pads and nudged towards fine leg
full, and on the stumps, and Gibbs is not taking undue risks, and defends
full and flighted, Gibbs plays with an open face, from in front of stumps
good bowling, thrown up, making Laxman wait, who flicks and is early into the shot, getting a leading edge
topspinner, thrown too close to Gibbs, so he plays it close to his body and opens the face for a single
again too full, and flicked away to fine leg
flighted high from round the stumps, too full, and an easy single to fine leg
full, into Gibbs's pads, and nudged to fine leg for a single
short on the stumps, and flicked by Laxman to midwicket
and Raina gets a wicket, just like Rohit Sharma did for Deccan, short and wide, but slow, and Gilchrist looks to make all the pace, and hits straight to short third man, in the air
slower this time, onto the pads, and guided into the leg side
quicker ball, looks to hoick, and misses
good stop off his own bowling, full bowl, drilled back and dives to his left
overpitched on off, Gilchrist right down to the pitch, and drives powerfully, straight of mid-off, what a shot, and a good over goes for six
worst appeal ever, pitched way outside leg and hit Gilchrist on the pad, only Murali appeals
toppie, pitches off, and takes the edge, a single to thirdman
beats him with a doosra, this pitched middle and ripped away, Gibbs hangs his bat
pitches it up, just outside off, Gibbs is cautious and defends
flighted offbreak outside leg, and helped away for a single to fine leg
another fulltoss, and he gets away with it again, played straight down to mid-off by Gibbs
fulltoss, on the pads, and Gilchrist can't get his timing, but still a single into the on side
and what a follow-up shot, on the pads, length ball, and the pick-up shot hits this towards pick-up truck on the road behind the fine-leg boundary
shot, top shot, proper cricketing cover-drive, length delivery, angling across, and Ginchrist gets his front foot down, and drives it between cover and extra cover. Fastest team 50 in this IPL
Gibbs steps out and makes room, Morkel follows him, and yorks him, just a single to mid-off
full and straight, already quicker than Gony and Bala, at 134ks, and played back to the bowler
slower offcutter, starts off stump, moves away, and Gilchrist plays with an open face towards point, no run
goes back to bowling a half-volley on the pads, and realises Gilly is showing no mercy, lifts it over long-on, a fielder is placed there but he is just a spectator
better angle, better length, not short enough, not full enough, starting off, and angling away, and Gilchrist defends
half-volley on the pads, 125ks, poor bowling, and Gilchrist heaves it over midwicket, making Bala pay
gentle pace, just back of a length, angling in, and Gilly plays the pick-up powerfully, and clears the field easily, what a start
slower ball, but way outside off
dropped, this was slow and short, Gilchrist looked to pull, but had to wait for a long time, and then went straight to Bala's right, Bala stretched his arm out, got a hand to it
Gony compensates, goes short, but too short for his pace, and it's on the pads, Gibbs just short-arms again, and it beats the fine leg, effortless batting, and 31 up in two overs
full, on the pads, and it's just a deft touch, flicked away gently between mid-on and midwicket, and that runs away for four
that was on the pads, and just nonchalantly flicked, a mere flick, but it clears fine leg, what timing
saw Gibbs coming down, bowled a bouncer, and it flies over his head, and Gibbs' scheme of stepping down is working in different ways
this is better, faster, 134ks, back of a length, on the stumps, and defended towards midwicket
and Gibbs treats Gony as a spinner, steps out right away, 128ks, gets close to the pitch, and lofts it straight over his head
back of a length, angling across, and Gilchrist nudges it to thirdman
good comeback for Bala, gets this to pitch on a length, just outside off, and holds its line, played towards the bowler again
this one swung in a bit, was in the same slot, so Gilchrist throws his arms again, gets a thick inside edge, and a single to deep backward square
in the slot again, length ball, just outside off, from round the stumps, and Gilly hits over extra, easy runs
gentle half-volley, outside off, that's easy meat for Gilly, who lofts it over mid-off, and Deccan are off
short and wide, cut aerially, but lands just short of point
